description: Delete a feature block from the active part (or part_id, an opaque surf id) and run that part through mutate, so the result status and errors are current and undo once restores the block. deleted: true means the block is gone; ok is the run after it, so ok: false with deleted: true is a later feature failing on the new solid (read errors), not a delete that did not happen: do not delete again. A face pick does not change the part: id and index resolve against the active part unless part_id names another row (a path or display name is unknown_part). A contour:<id> chip, the bare contour id, or that chip's index deletes the @contour statement. A contour a feature still names is confirm_required until confirm: true, which also drops those features. Deleting the feature that declares part while later code still uses it is confirm_required until confirm: true; the result then carries a warning. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

confirm.description: Required true to delete the feature that declares part while later code still uses it

part_id.description: Opaque surf id of the part whose feature is deleted. Omit to use the active part. A face pick does not change the target. A path or display name is unknown_part.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: delete_feature
